description: Adds Apotheosis loot category compat for Spartan Weaponry, Epic Knights, L'Ender's Cataclysm, Alex's Mobs, T.O Magic 'n Extras, Fallen Gems & Affixes, and more.

mods.name: Apothic Category Compat
mods.description: Universal Apotheosis loot category support. Every melee weapon is sorted into sword or heavy_weapon by its attack speed using Obscure API's thresholds, while bows, crossbows, tridents, shields, tools, and armor are read from the vanilla class hierarchy, so any mod's gear can roll affixes and gems regardless of which item class it uses. Includes targeted overrides for the custom class ranged weapons and plain Item shields in L_Ender's Cataclysm, Tetra, Meet Your Fight, Alex's Mobs, The Undergarden, and Twilight Forest.

releases.notes:
# v2.1.0

## Added

- Name-based sword rule that routes items ending in "sword" to Sword, even when their speed and damage would otherwise land them in Heavy Weapon.
- Epic Fight weapon support, including a stack-level attribute fallback for addons that put their damage on the stack instead of the item.

## Changed

- Renamed from Apothic Compat to Apothic Category Compat, so pack manifests need to point at the new slug apothic-category-compat. Configs auto-migrate on first launch so existing settings carry over.
- Reload command short alias changed to /acc, and the long form follows the new mod id.
- Twilight Forest Block and Chain now routes to Crossbow instead of Bow, since it throws a heavy chained projectile that fits the crossbow affix pool better.
- Twilight Forest Cube of Annihilation now routes through the weapon_pickaxes_as_heavy toggle, defaulting to Heavy Weapon and dropping to Pickaxe when the toggle is off.
- name_based_heavy_override default is now true. Existing configs keep their current value, so set it to true or delete the config to pick up the new default.

mods.name: Apothic Category Compat
mods.description: Adds a loot category data map for items Apotheosis 8.x does not categorize on its own: gun style ranged weapons, Lands of Icaria bidents, and dual purpose pickaxe weapons. With Apothic Compats and Malum present, it also routes modded staffs and scythes to their categories. Keeps the config driven affix blacklist.

releases.notes:
# v2.1.0

## Added

- Lands of Icaria bidents now route to Trident.
- Around 30 modded staffs (Iron's Spellbooks, Twilight Forest scepters, Ice and Fire, Forbidden Arcanus, and more) now route to apothic_compats:staff when both Apothic Compats and Malum are loaded.
- Lands of Icaria scythes route to apothic_compats:scythe under the same condition.
- Cataclysm Void Forge, Infernal Forge, and Forbidden Arcanus blacksmith gavels now route to Melee Weapon through a new tag, controlled by the weapon_pickaxes_as_melee config toggle (default true).

## Changed

- Renamed from Apothic Compat to Apothic Category Compat, so pack manifests need to point at the new slug apothic-category-compat. Configs auto-migrate on first launch so existing settings carry over.
- Reload command short alias changed to /acc, and the long form follows the new mod id.

## Notes

- Pack devs can add more items to the #apothic_category_compat:weapon_pickaxes tag in their own datapack to extend the pickaxe routing.
- Use the vanilla /reload after editing weapon_pickaxes_as_melee since /acc reload only refreshes the affix blacklist.

releases.notes:
# v2.0.2

First release on NeoForge 1.21.1 with Apotheosis 8.x.

## What this version does

Apotheosis 8.x replaced the IMC override channel with a NeoForge Data Map and merged the sword and heavy weapon categories into a single melee weapon category. Its native predicates now auto-categorize the vast majority of modded weapons. Apothic Compat on 1.21.1 fills the remaining gaps with a static Data Map of category overrides for items that Apoth's predicates miss.

## Items overridden

- Alex's Caves Raygun, Dreadbow as bow
- Alex's Mobs Hemolymph Blaster, Blood Sprayer as bow
- Born in Chaos Pumpkin Pistol as bow
- Cataclysm Cursed Bow, Wrath of the Desert, Void Assault Shoulder Weapon, Wither Assault Shoulder Weapon, Laser Gatling as bow
- The Undergarden Slingshot as bow
- Twilight Forest Block and Chain, Cube of Annihilation as bow

## Notes

- Hard dependency on Apotheosis 8.5 or newer (8.x)
- Affix blacklist feature still present
- The 1.20.1 features that no longer apply on 1.21.1 (universal speed-and-damage rule, sword vs heavy split, TOML config item and tag overrides) have been removed since Apoth 8.x does not expose the mechanisms they relied on
